title: Persona expansion uses multi-page routes with role-gated nav — each page keeps its own 'one surface, one panel' rule
context: Track 1 (admin, compliance, approvals) needs to grow the app beyond the single treasurer surface without breaking the panel-over-surface pattern.
decision: Add top-nav routes: `/` (treasurer, unchanged), `/admin`, `/compliance`, `/approvals`. Each route has its own strip and panels; each keeps the 'one panel at a time' rule. Nav entries are gated by role — a user only sees the pages their roles permit.
alternatives_rejected: Everything in the single strip (rejected — a compliance officer scrolling a decade of audit trail needs the full canvas, not a right-side panel)
consequences: New shared PageShell component wrapping the top-nav + persona-labelled header
Route-level auth in the frontend (hasRole helper reading from /auth/me)
Backend endpoints for admin/compliance/approvals live under prefixed tags with require_role decorators
Treasurer view stays byte-for-byte identical to today's shape
